# Image decoder fixtures. Generated by gen_fixtures.py (Pillow + ImageMagick).
# exact <file> <w> <h> <fnv1a64 of the expected RGBA8 bytes>
# jpeg  <file> <ref/file.png>   expected = libjpeg-turbo's decode (Pillow); compared within a tolerance
# gif   <file> <frames> <w> <h> <fnv1a64 of all frames' RGBA8 then each delay as int32 LE>
# reject <file>                 must fail to decode
# Provenance of the expected pixels: PNG/BMP/TGA/GIF come from libpng / libbmp / Pillow's readers
# (Pillow's libpng bundle), JPEG from libjpeg-turbo. Where those readers use a different convention
# than the one our engine has always had from stb_image (16-bit tRNS keys, 555/565 channel scaling,
# 32-bit BMP alpha, GIF transparent pixels, HDR tone mapping, PSD matte removal), the expected
# bytes are the long-standing stb_image convention, cross-checked bit for bit before stb was
# removed. Animated GIF disposal 3 was checked against Pillow's compositor.
